name: r5-conn-conflict-order
description: Fix round connections (item 6): dispatch.js findConflict reads the device's expectations ORDER BY rowid DESC and walks them with their occurrences before the active occurrences that have none; the first owner that holds answers valve_busy, the first malformed transport_json refuses the command. Go walked the occurrences in the order of its join (by command_id), so it met a different owner first; and it answered a malformed owner with UNKNOWN and a REJECTED_PERMANENT ledger row (its detail was the JSON parser's 'invalid character' text).

steps.why: Two RESERVED conditional occurrences per valve, each with its expectation. C1: the expectation inserted first (and the lower command_id) has malformed transport_json, the later one holds (no effect snapshot, no expiry): Node-RED meets the later one first and answers 409 valve_busy. C2: the reverse: Node-RED meets the malformed owner first; parsePersistedJson's errorWithCode('transport_state_malformed') becomes the 503's error, and the FAILED ack (detail 'persisted safety JSON is malformed') is retryable, so nothing reaches applied_commands.
